## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Feb 25, 2026 - Jul 22, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _RealCaden_, Jul 16, 2026, 1/5: "Worst app I’ve ever used, it’s never working. I’ve had so many issues with this app, I’ve tried countless tutorials trying to fix it and it never helps."
            2. _Tadow5_, Jul 22, 2026, 2/5: "I’ve made every monthly goal for over two years now. But this month the goal only displayed for the first week of the month. And now with only eleven days left, the goal finally reappears to let me know I’ve missed this monthly goal by ONE DAY!. Years of progress and trophies broken by sketchy software. The broken workouts that continuously stop partway through is annoying enough. But destroying a years-long streak because you refuse to track my progress is unacceptable. Update this app like you do all the others!"
            3. _dubaaks_, Jul 11, 2026, 2/5: "1. All workouts could use an option to turn off music or keep it absolutely minimum volume. The “trainer focus” mode is BROKEN! 2. Workouts could be classified based on intensity and/or complexity. Most of Dice’s yoga are intermediate to advanced, resulting in sprained wrist or back. 3. Unlike HIIT, run and bike workouts can be easy. Easiest runs are at moderate intensity, unsure what that means for heart rate zones; and easiest rides have “hard” and “all out” intervals."
